mods.notes: Unlocks Axe Knight as an ability you get with the random "?" pick, by editing the mint code, in single player and multiplayer but not story mode. It is for the Europe 3.0 version only, and the author marks it outdated in favour of Playable Story NPCs.

mods.name: Green Screen Room
mods.title: Kirby Battle Royale
mods.author: JC Players
mods.notes: Turns the Training Room into a green screen room with a close top view, edited Kirby animations, a no-hat Qibby and Bandana Dee in place of the Spear Waddle Dee. The Qibby move crashes if you charge it. The page does not say which regions it was made for, so other versions are untested.

mods.name: Original Toad Voice
mods.title: Luigi's Mansion
mods.author: JomSpoons
mods.notes: Restores Toad's voice from the GameCube release by replacing the game's sound archive. It is for the USA version, and the author says not to install it through OnionFS because that breaks the C-Stick.

mods.name: Blue Robomb
mods.title: Luigi's Mansion: Dark Moon
mods.author: feldright
mods.notes: Replaces the texture of the normal Robombs in the ScareScraper with a blue one by editing the level bundle. The author calls it a hex-editing experiment and says it works on any region of the game.

mods.name: 60 fps Patch (Game v1.2)
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story + Bowser Jr.'s Journey
mods.author: struktured
mods.notes: Unlocks 60 fps with a code patch; holding R drops back to 30 fps where the game misbehaves. It is for the USA game with the 1.2 update installed, and the wrong version freezes on a black screen. It replaces other code patches for the game.

mods.name: 60 fps Patch (Game v1.0)
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story + Bowser Jr.'s Journey
mods.author: struktured
mods.notes: Unlocks 60 fps with a code patch; holding R drops back to 30 fps where the game misbehaves. It is for the USA game without the update, which is version 1.0, and the wrong version freezes on a black screen. It replaces other code patches for the game.

mods.name: DX Hard Mode
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story + Bowser Jr.'s Journey
mods.author: Danius
mods.notes: A hard-mode hack with 1.5 times enemy HP and defence, 2.5 times power, three extra levels, faster and harder attacks, an item limit of 10 and Easy Mode removed. It is early work in progress, replaces the game code and many data files, and is for the version 1.2 game in the USA and Europe.

mods.name: SM64 Mario and Luigi
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Dream Team
mods.author: NintendoGameTuber
mods.notes: Gives Mario and Luigi their Super Mario 64 models in the Giant Battles by replacing the HugeBattle model files. The extra Textures folder on the page is source material and is not installed. The page does not say which regions it was made for, so other versions are untested.

mods.name: Mario & Louis: Suspicious Drunk Driving
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Dream Team
mods.author: Zeta64
mods.notes: A Google Translate text hack of the game, with the text put through many rounds of machine translation, plus redrawn textures. The author warns it has swearing and adult themes. It is for the USA version and the text in the English folder.

mods.name: NoExp/Coins
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Dream Team
mods.author: Nahnegnal
mods.notes: Removes the experience and coin drops from enemies with a code patch. It is for the USA version and replaces other code patches for the game. Its solid RAR cannot be unpacked by the system bsdtar, so the install may fail.

mods.name: Book of Mario Bros. (HD Textures)
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
mods.author: Zeta64
mods.notes: A Google Translate hack of Paper Jam that puts the text through many rounds of machine translation, and also redraws many textures to match. It is for the European version only, and the author warns it has adult content. Its static.crr file is not installed.

mods.name: Book of Mario Bros. (Low-Res Textures)
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
mods.author: Zeta64
mods.notes: A Google Translate hack of Paper Jam that puts the text through many rounds of machine translation, and also redraws many textures to match. It is for the European version only, and the author warns it has adult content. Its static.crr file is not installed.

mods.name: NoExp/Coins
mods.title: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
mods.author: Nahnegnal
mods.notes: Removes the experience and coin drops from enemies by replacing the DB data file. It is for the European version, and it clashes with other mods that replace the same file. Its solid RAR cannot be unpacked by the system bsdtar, so the install may fail.

mods.name: Super Mario and the Crystal Crescents
mods.title: New Super Mario Bros. 2
mods.author: Rimea
mods.notes: A one-world mod with eight new levels, custom graphics, a new soundtrack and a custom world map. It covers the standard, Gold and Special editions of the game. It replaces other New Super Mario Bros. 2 level mods, which edit the same files, and the 141 MB download is over the app's current size limit.

mods.name: Super Mario Bros. Next: The Lost Levels (Part 1)
mods.title: New Super Mario Bros. 2
mods.author: hus_mighty
mods.notes: The first half of a collection of levels cut from the Super Mario Bros. Next project, with new courses, models and music. Parts 1 and 2 are separate halves and overwrite each other, so use one at a time. Replaces other New Super Mario Bros. 2 level mods.

mods.name: Super Mario Bros. Next: The Lost Levels (Part 2)
mods.title: New Super Mario Bros. 2
mods.author: hus_mighty
mods.notes: The second half of the Lost Levels collection from the Super Mario Bros. Next project, with more cut courses, models and music. Parts 1 and 2 overwrite each other, so use one at a time. Replaces other New Super Mario Bros. 2 level mods; the 121 MB download is close to the app's size limit.

mods.name: New Super Mario Bros. 3DS
mods.title: New Super Mario Bros. 2
mods.author: Nick64 Mods
mods.notes: A two-world mod that changes every stage, the cannons and the Toad houses. It covers the standard, Gold and Special editions. Replaces other New Super Mario Bros. 2 level mods; the 144 MB download is over the app's current size limit, and a few preview images in the pack are copied into the mod folder but are never used.

mods.name: SM64 Mario and SM64 Luigi
mods.title: New Super Mario Bros. 2
mods.author: NintendoGameTuber
mods.notes: Swaps the playable Mario and Luigi for their Super Mario 64 models, including the cutscene models. It covers the standard, Gold and Special editions. It replaces the player models, so it clashes with other character mods.

mods.name: New Super Mario Bros. 2: Retro Remix
mods.title: New Super Mario Bros. 2
mods.author: Luigi23
mods.notes: Remakes levels from Super Mario Bros., The Lost Levels, Super Mario Bros. 3, Super Mario World and New Super Mario Bros. in every world, each with three star coins. It covers the standard, Gold and Special editions. The newest regular version is downloaded; the Gold variant is not installed, and it replaces other level mods.

mods.name: Paper Mario: Sticker Star TTYD Style
mods.title: Paper Mario: Sticker Star
mods.author: Juggling gamer
mods.notes: Restyles the game after the first three Paper Mario games: new models, sprites, text, music and a full retexture of the world. It is built for the European game, so the North American and Japanese versions are not covered. The pack is about 846 MB, far over the app's size limit, and its optional emblem textures are not installed.

mods.name: Mario Animation Revamp
mods.title: Paper Mario: Sticker Star
mods.author: Br123 T T
mods.notes: Gives Mario smoother animations and extra scripted moves for the North American and European versions. Only the Smooth animation set is installed; the Choppy set, the extra back animations and the Paper Mario 64 and TTYD battle animations are not, because they overlap or can cause cutscene glitches. It replaces other Mario animation or script mods.

mods.name: Infinite Jump and Hammer
mods.title: Paper Mario: Sticker Star
mods.author: JoeL.
mods.notes: Gives you back the jump or hammer sticker as soon as you use it in battle, including the shiny versions, so they never run out. It edits only battle scripts. Only the North American version was checked by the author; the European and Japanese title IDs are included on the assumption that the scripts are shared.

mods.name: AI Sticker Star
mods.title: Paper Mario: Sticker Star
mods.author: Mayro
mods.notes: Replaces the game's English text with AI-generated text, written from the first few words of each line. It includes swearing and sensitive topics and does not change images such as the Talk prompt. It edits the US English messages only, so it works on the North American version.

mods.name: Skippable Dialogue
mods.title: Paper Mario: Sticker Star
mods.author: FlareDoesThing
mods.notes: Lets you skip almost every line of dialogue. It replaces a single script file, so it clashes with other script mods. The author only states that it works on Sticker Star, so the European and Japanese title IDs are unconfirmed.

mods.name: Super Luigi Maker
mods.title: Super Mario Maker for Nintendo 3DS
mods.author: Ultmate_Mario
mods.notes: Ports the Wii U Super Luigi Maker look to three of the four game styles by replacing the player models. The New Super Mario Bros. U style still shows Mario and the flags do not work, as the author notes. It clashes with other model mods for this game.

mods.name: All-Stars Mod (SMB1 + SMB3)
mods.title: Super Mario Maker for Nintendo 3DS
mods.author: realguest3920
mods.notes: Replaces the 8-bit Super Mario Bros. and Super Mario Bros. 3 styles with the 16-bit All-Stars art. It is unfinished: the enemy sprites, sounds, question blocks and brick blocks are not ported yet. The 624 MB archive is far over the app's size limit and its layout was read from the file list only.

mods.name: Super Mario Maker 2 Themes
mods.title: Super Mario Maker for Nintendo 3DS
mods.author: Ghost2083043
mods.notes: Brings the Super Mario Maker 2 themes and music into the 3DS game as loose game files. The archive has no romfs folder, so the install rules place its folders inside romfs. The 95 MB download replaces a lot of the game's tile and sound data, so it clashes with other style mods.

mods.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder Gamestyle
mods.title: Super Mario Maker for Nintendo 3DS
mods.author: Ghost3976408
mods.notes: Replaces the whole New Super Mario Bros. U game style with Super Mario Bros. Wonder themes, tilesets, semi-solids, sound effects and music. It also changes the editor music, backgrounds and palette icons. The 275 MB download is over the app's size limit and the style it replaces is gone while it is installed.

mods.name: Ultimate Moveset in All Gamestyles
mods.title: Super Mario Maker for Nintendo 3DS
mods.author: Ghost2209397
mods.notes: Gives every game style an expanded moveset, such as wall jump in the Super Mario Bros. style and spin jump in the Super Mario Bros. 3 style. It is four small data files. It clashes with other mods that edit the same move data.

mods.name: Klonoa over Mario
mods.title: Mario Party: Island Tour
mods.author: Miokai
mods.notes: Replaces Mario's model with Klonoa. It is a model swap only and was made for the North American game; the author says it also runs on a real console. The European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed, and Mario is gone while it is installed.

mods.name: Mario (Super Mario 64)
mods.title: Mario Party: Island Tour
mods.author: ExoDendrite
mods.notes: Replaces Mario's model with the Super Mario 64 version, with working mesh animations. It is a model swap only, and the zip has no romfs folder, so the install rules add it. The European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed.

mods.name: Waluigi (Mario Party 3), RGBA4
mods.title: Mario Party: Island Tour
mods.author: ExoDendrite
mods.notes: Swaps one character model for Waluigi as he appears in Mario Party 3, using RGBA4 textures for better quality. It is a model swap only and takes a slot, so that character is gone while it is installed. Use the ETC1A4 entry instead for the lighter version; the two overwrite each other.

mods.name: Waluigi (Mario Party 3), ETC1A4
mods.title: Mario Party: Island Tour
mods.author: ExoDendrite
mods.notes: The same Mario Party 3 Waluigi model swap, using ETC1A4 textures that are lighter on the system but a little lower in quality. It takes a character slot, so that character is gone while it is installed. It overwrites the RGBA4 version, so use only one.

mods.name: Robo-Mario
mods.title: Mario Party: Island Tour
mods.author: ExoDendrite
mods.notes: Puts the Robo-Mario model from Mario Kart Arcade GP in Mario's slot. It is a model swap only, and the zip has no romfs folder, so the install rules add it. Mario is gone while it is installed.

mods.name: Fire Bros.
mods.title: Mario Party: Star Rush
mods.author: ExoDendrite
mods.notes: Retextures Mario, Luigi, Wario and Waluigi as their fire variants. There is no menu art yet, and the zip has no romfs folder, so the install rules add it. The European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed.

mods.name: Morgana (Persona 5) over Yoshi
mods.title: Mario Party: Star Rush
mods.author: Miokai
mods.notes: Replaces Yoshi with Morgana from Persona 5 and changes some of the menu art. The author says it only works in the emulator and not on a real 3DS, and that it is unfinished. Yoshi is gone while it is installed.

mods.name: Klonoa
mods.title: Mario Party: Star Rush
mods.author: Miokai
mods.notes: Puts Klonoa in Mario's slot. The author notes it has no menu art yet, and Mario is gone while it is installed. The European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed.

mods.name: Red Yoshi
mods.title: Mario Party: Star Rush
mods.author: Theovennce2
mods.notes: Retextures the green Yoshi red, which then shows in the minigames. It replaces the normal Yoshi texture file, so it clashes with other Yoshi mods. The contents are a single texture file, and the European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed.

mods.name: No Amiibo Icon for Characters
mods.title: Mario Party: Star Rush
mods.author: Darkness Illusion
mods.notes: Removes the small amiibo tag that sits above a character's head after you use their amiibo. It replaces one UI file and works on the North American version. It clashes with other mods that edit the same menu file.

mods.name: SM64 Mario
mods.title: Mario Tennis Open
mods.author: NintendoGameTuber
mods.notes: Replaces Mario's player model with the Super Mario 64 version, including the trophy ceremony model. It is two model files, so it clashes with other Mario model mods. The author names no region, so the European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed.

mods.name: SM64 Luigi
mods.title: Mario Tennis Open
mods.author: NintendoGameTuber
mods.notes: Replaces Luigi's player model with the Super Mario 64 version, including the ceremony model. It is two model files and clashes with other Luigi model mods. The author names no region, so the European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed.

mods.name: SM64 Metal Mario
mods.title: Mario Tennis Open
mods.author: NintendoGameTuber
mods.notes: Replaces the Metal Mario player model with the Super Mario 64 version, including the ceremony model. It is two model files and clashes with other Metal Mario mods. The author names no region, so the European and Japanese title IDs are included but unconfirmed.

mods.name: Sonic over Diddy Kong
mods.title: Mario Tennis Open
mods.author: ouch9922
mods.notes: Replaces Diddy Kong with Sonic the Hedgehog, with new character and ceremony models plus voice and sound files. The zip has no romfs folder, so the install rules add it. Diddy Kong is gone while it is installed, and the European and Japanese title IDs are unconfirmed.

mods.name: Rosalina over Peach
mods.title: Mario Tennis Open
mods.author: ouch9922
mods.notes: Replaces Peach with Rosalina, with new character and ceremony models plus sound files. The zip has no romfs folder, so the install rules add it. Peach is gone while it is installed, and the European and Japanese title IDs are unconfirmed.

mods.name: Katyusha Threemix over The Gypsy Dance
mods.title: Tetris Axis
mods.author: Imora
mods.notes: Replaces the Gypsy Dance track in Capture Mode with the previously unused Katyusha Threemix, and changes the matching name in the English text. The author only tested the North American version, and it replaces the whole sound archive, so it clashes with other music mods. The 74 MB download is under the app's size limit but sizeable.

mods.name: Brazilian Portuguese Translation
mods.title: Radiant Historia: Perfect Chronology
mods.author: Ahtheerr
mods.notes: A Brazilian Portuguese translation covering the story, side quests, items and most menus. It replaces the game's message and font files, and the contents are about 17,000 small files. GameBanana has not marked the file as scanned clean, which the app requires, so the download is refused until that changes.

mods.name: HD Remaster Portraits
mods.title: Etrian Odyssey II Untold: The Fafnir Knight
mods.author: Nicole Beans
mods.notes: Adds the new class portraits from the Etrian Odyssey HD Remaster by overwriting the extra DLC portrait slots. It needs the Yggdrasil Veteran DLC portrait pack installed, otherwise only one new portrait shows. The 1.1 GB download replaces the game's main data archive.

mods.name: Shiny Lock Removal
mods.title: Pokémon Sun
mods.author: crashandcortex
mods.notes: Removes the shiny lock from the game, so every legendary and gift Pokémon can be shiny. It ships a patched game code file, so it only works with the base 1.0.0 game; delete any installed update data first. It clashes with other code patches and does not include the Zygarde and in-game trade version.

mods.name: Trans Pride Ride Gear
mods.title: Pokémon Sun / Pokémon Moon
mods.author: Primm
mods.notes: Recolours the Ride Gear in the light pink and blue of the trans flag, for both the girl and boy characters. It replaces four model files, so it clashes with other Ride Gear mods. It is a game-file replacement, not a texture pack.

mods.name: Playable Lillie
mods.title: Pokémon Sun / Pokémon Moon
mods.author: Camyoshi
mods.notes: Replaces the male player character with Lillie, with matching overworld, battle and Ride outfit models for every clothing piece except glasses. Only the model files are installed; the optional dialogue changes that refer to Lillie are not. It clashes with other player model mods.

mods.name: Accurate Pokémon Sizes
mods.title: Pokémon Ultra Sun / Pokémon Ultra Moon
mods.author: The Pod
mods.notes: Adjusts battle and overworld sizes so Pokémon match their real-world sizes. It replaces the Pokémon model archive, so any other mod that edits that file needs merging with it first. The 703 MB download is far over the app's size limit, and the author notes that Salandit shows only outlines.

mods.name: Uhuru Gift (Korean), Gen 8 and 9 Expansion
mods.title: Pokémon Ultra Sun
mods.author: kingksb0120
mods.notes: An unofficial Korean edition of Aqua's Gen 8 and 9 expansion, adding Terastal, Dynamax, tournaments, Boss Rush and a roguelike tower. It needs Pokémon Ultra Sun (USA) version 1.0 with no update data. The mod-folder build is about 6.5 GB on Google Drive, far over the app's size limit, and it replaces the game code and data.

mods.name: Hero of Time: Young Link
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Swaps Link for the Young Link of Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, with a Kokiri Sword, Deku Shield, Hero's Shield and more. Only one Link model can be active at a time, so it clashes with the Adult Link entry and other Link mods. The voice pack is a separate download and is not installed.

mods.name: Hero of Time: Adult Link
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Swaps Link for the Adult Link of Ocarina of Time, with matching equipment. Only one Link model can be active at a time, so it clashes with the Young Link entry and other Link mods. The voice pack is a separate download and is not installed.

mods.name: Toon Link Between Worlds
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Lets you play as Toon Link using the Tri Force Heroes model, with Wind Waker-style swords and shields and edited cutscenes. It clashes with other Link model mods. The Wind Waker voice pack is a separate download and is not installed.

mods.name: Fighter's Shield over Basic Shield
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Adds the Fighter's Shield from A Link to the Past in place of the basic orange shield. The three shield variants overwrite each other, so use only one. The separate files for manual merging are not installed.

mods.name: Fighter's Shield over Hylian Shield
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Adds the Fighter's Shield from A Link to the Past in place of the Hylian Shield. The three shield variants overwrite each other, so use only one. The separate files for manual merging are not installed.

mods.name: Fighter's Shield and Red Shield
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Replaces the basic orange shield with the Fighter's Shield and the Hylian Shield with a red shield. The three shield variants overwrite each other, so use only one. The separate files for manual merging are not installed.

mods.name: A Linkle between Worlds: Hooded Linkle
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Potocto
mods.notes: Changes Link to Linkle with the green hood, with her voice and some dialogue tweaks. The four Linkle variants overwrite each other, so use only one. The 60 MB download is under the app's size limit but replaces many of the game's model archives.

mods.name: A Linkle between Worlds: Hoodless Linkle
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Potocto
mods.notes: Changes Link to Linkle without the hood, with her voice and some dialogue tweaks. The four Linkle variants overwrite each other, so use only one. The 60 MB download is under the app's size limit but replaces many of the game's model archives.

mods.name: A Linkle between Worlds: Hooded Linkle (Pink Hair)
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Potocto
mods.notes: Changes Link to Linkle with the green hood and pink hair, with her voice and some dialogue tweaks. The four Linkle variants overwrite each other, so use only one. The 60 MB download is under the app's size limit but replaces many of the game's model archives.

mods.name: A Linkle between Worlds: Hoodless Linkle (Pink Hair)
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Potocto
mods.notes: Changes Link to Linkle without the hood and with pink hair, with her voice and some dialogue tweaks. The four Linkle variants overwrite each other, so use only one. The 60 MB download is under the app's size limit but replaces many of the game's model archives.

mods.name: Wolf Link between Worlds
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
mods.author: Potocto
mods.notes: Replaces Link with Wolf Link, a commissioned mod that the author says also works on console. It replaces the Link model archives, so it clashes with other Link model mods.

mods.name: Light Blue + Pink Link Combined (North America)
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes
mods.author: Pebnut
mods.notes: Recolours two of the Links light blue and pink at once, by editing the shared costume and course textures for the North America version. It replaces many of the game's costume files, so it clashes with other Link recolour mods. The matching colour cheat is a separate download and is not installed.

mods.name: Hero of Time Outfits
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Adds Young Link and Adult Link as outfits, replacing the Kokiri Clothes and the Sword Suit by default. You can swap them to other slots by renaming the files, as the included list explains. Disable other costume mods first; the Adult Link voice pack is a separate download and is not installed.

mods.name: LBW Link (Blonde)
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes
mods.author: Kobatuwu
mods.notes: Adds the Link Between Worlds design in place of the Hero's Tunic, with blonde hair for all the Links. The model was built from an unused High Fairy costume. It is made for the North American version and overwrites the Multi-Coloured Hair version.

mods.name: LBW Link (Multi-Coloured Hair)
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes
mods.author: Kobatuwu
mods.notes: Adds the Link Between Worlds design in place of the Hero's Tunic, with a different hair colour for each Link. The model was built from an unused High Fairy costume. It is made for the North American version and overwrites the Blonde version.

mods.name: Blond Links
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes
mods.author: Takeshre
mods.notes: Keeps Link's hair blond in multiplayer whatever colour the player is, and removes the yellow stripe from the Hero's Tunic hat. It also updates the matching UI and communication icons for the North American, European, Japanese and Korean versions. It clashes with other costume mods,.

mods.name: Pink Link Mod
mods.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes
mods.author: 0atmeal
mods.notes: Recolours the red Link pink across all 39 outfits, the multiplayer emotes, the loading screen icons, the Poes and the platforms. The author says it only works with the English North American version. It clashes with other Link recolour mods.

mods.name: Clean Texture Pack
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: maniman303
mods.notes: Replaces the grass, snow, cliff and sky textures in a New Horizons-inspired style, cleans up the villagers' fur and redoes a few wallpapers, the giant teddy bears and the TIY banner. Its files come from the Europe Welcome amiibo release, so the USA and Europe versions of the base game and of Welcome amiibo are listed. The author calls it a work in progress, and it replaces the same files as other New Leaf look mods.

mods.name: Wolfsbane Cut (Unisex)
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Zelda wig with a longer, unisex wolf-cut hairstyle that can be coloured and has a glowing star charm. This is the build the author made for the 3DS; a no-star version and a note for Japanese games are on the page but not installed. You need to own the Zelda wig in your game to see it.

mods.name: Census Menu Restoration
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: pearl23
mods.notes: Restores the Census menu with its values and title text. It needs a save editor (ACSE) or the Vapecord plugin to switch the menu on in your save, so it does nothing on its own. This is the newest of four archive versions on the page.

mods.name: Elf Ears (Lighter Tones)
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Superhero mask accessory with pointed ears made for lighter skin tones. It is an accessory, so it can be worn with a hat or wig, and you need the Superhero mask in your game to see it. The five ear variants replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Elf Ears (Darker Tones)
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Superhero mask accessory with pointed ears made for darker skin tones. It is an accessory, so it can be worn with a hat or wig, and you need the Superhero mask in your game to see it. The five ear variants replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Superhero mask accessory with pointed ears made for medium or tan skin tones. It is an accessory, so it can be worn with a hat or wig, and you need the Superhero mask in your game to see it. The five ear variants replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Elf Ears (Fairy (Zombie, Green))

mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Superhero mask accessory with pointed ears made for green skin colour, as fairy ears. It is an accessory, so it can be worn with a hat or wig, and you need the Superhero mask in your game to see it. The five ear variants replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Elf Ears (Fairy (Rose, Pink))

mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Superhero mask accessory with pointed ears made for pink skin colour, as fairy ears. It is an accessory, so it can be worn with a hat or wig, and you need the Superhero mask in your game to see it. The five ear variants replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Baby Twintails (Blackberry)
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Pigtail wig with a bigger, retouched twintails hairstyle with bangs, in black. The wig cannot be recoloured in game, which is why each colour is its own download. The four colours replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Baby Twintails (Blondie)
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Pigtail wig with a bigger, retouched twintails hairstyle with bangs, in blonde. The wig cannot be recoloured in game, which is why each colour is its own download. The four colours replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Baby Twintails (Brownie)
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Pigtail wig with a bigger, retouched twintails hairstyle with bangs, in brown. The wig cannot be recoloured in game, which is why each colour is its own download. The four colours replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Baby Twintails (Bubblegum)
mods.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
mods.author: .+MangoMikkii+.
mods.licence: Free for personal use only; not for sale or reposting
mods.notes: Replaces the Pigtail wig with a bigger, retouched twintails hairstyle with bangs, in pink. The wig cannot be recoloured in game, which is why each colour is its own download. The four colours replace the same file, so install only one.

mods.name: Star Dog Modpack
mods.title: Star Fox 64 3D
mods.author: CONINJA_2002
mods.notes: Replaces some voice clips with new fan recordings (Molly, Goldie, Chica and Coninja so far) and also replaces some textures, the character portraits. The author says it works only on Azahar, and it is an early access release, so most characters are still to come. It is for the USA version only, as its folders are named for that title ID.

mods.name: Final Speech Restoration
mods.title: Star Fox 64 3D
mods.author: Redstormmars
mods.notes: Replaces four of the game's speech lines with the uncompressed N64 recordings, which the author prefers for their intonation. It covers the USA and Europe versions. The author made it for a real 3DS, so it has not been confirmed on Azahar.

mods.name: No Bloom
mods.title: Metroid: Samus Returns
mods.author: sabre230
mods.notes: Hides the bloom glow by changing one post-processing shader, which suits a reshade or a cleaner look. The author says it has not been tested widely and may break things or not work on a real 3DS. The file sits loose in the download, so the install folder is taken from the older version of the same mod.

mods.name: Shadow the Hedgehog (Hover)
mods.title: Sonic Generations
mods.author: DanielGamerDX
mods.notes: Makes Shadow playable in all the Modern stages with hover running animations, adds a Modern Sonic boss fight in Radical Highway, and lets Super Shadow and Super Sonic team up against the final boss. It also replaces some textures and a large game archive (about 590 MB), and works with the English, French, German, Spanish and Italian voices. The two versions replace the same files, so install only one; the page names no region.

mods.name: Shadow the Hedgehog (Skate)
mods.title: Sonic Generations
mods.author: DanielGamerDX
mods.notes: Makes Shadow playable in all the Modern stages with skate running animations, adds a Modern Sonic boss fight in Radical Highway, and lets Super Shadow and Super Sonic team up against the final boss. It also replaces some textures and a large game archive (about 590 MB), and works with the English, French, German, Spanish and Italian voices. The two versions replace the same files, so install only one; the page names no region.

mods.name: Legacy Skin Pack
mods.title: Sonic Generations
mods.author: DanielGamerDX
mods.notes: Swaps in Sonic Jam Classic Sonic and Sonic Adventure Modern Sonic models, ported from the Sonic X Shadow Generations DLC, including in cutscenes. It also replaces some textures and a large game archive (about 590 MB). The author could not test it on a real 3DS, and the page names no region.

mods.name: Definitive Sonic Models
mods.title: Sonic Generations
mods.author: DanielGamerDX
mods.notes: Replaces the low-poly gameplay models of Classic and Modern Sonic, and their Super forms, with the detailed cutscene models. This is the recommended version; an older "high quality models" version on the page is not installed. It is one 590 MB game archive, so it clashes with other Sonic Generations model mods.

mods.name: Brazilian Portuguese
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH
mods.author: Math_kk
mods.notes: Translates the story, interface and more into Brazilian Portuguese (the Traducoes Komainu patch, version 1.3.2). It works only with the USA version 1.0, so do not install the game update. The download is a 238 MB archive on the author's Google Drive.

mods.name: Yo-Kaizo Watch
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH
mods.author: Woganog
mods.notes: A hard mode with much stronger bosses, a weaker Holy Exporb, changed boss rewards and new textures, movies and sounds. It is for the Europe version and only works as intended with the game language set to English (GB). It replaces the main game archive (about 600 MB), and the author asks players not to use the Infinite Attack Exploit.

mods.name: Undub
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH
mods.author: Ocleg
mods.notes: Restores the Japanese voices and Yo-kai names, undubs the story text and textures, and brings back the uncensored NPC designs, the Japanese title background, the Terror Time icons and the original intro. Update the game to the latest version first. It is a 1 GB download that replaces the main game archive; the page names no region, and it ships both the English and the Europe sound banks.

mods.name: Revisited
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH
mods.author: Whisperito
mods.notes: A quality-of-life pack: a Yo-kai Watch 2 style interface (not every menu), every Exporb for sale in Whatta Find, Pandanoko always in the Wayfarer Manor VIP room, Orcanos's fight marks and Pandanoko's dialogue artwork. The download is one loose game archive (573 MB) on the author's Google Drive, and the Europe version is inferred from its size because the page does not say.

mods.name: French Dub by Kirbendo
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH
mods.author: Kirbendo
mods.notes: Replaces the cutscene voices with a French dub by the YouTuber Kirbendo, and each Yo-kai now says an extra line when you befriend it, voiced by community members. It also replaces some item and medal graphics. French only, for the Europe version, and the download is 387 MB.

mods.name: Yo-Kaizo Watch 2
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH 2
mods.author: Woganog
mods.notes: A hard mode with buffed main bosses and other bosses, nerfed items, lower experience and a cheat word (Cheater) for the password items. This is the English (GB) build for the Europe versions of Bony Spirits and Fleshy Souls, and the French build is a separate download. The download is 896 MB and replaces the game's main archives.

mods.name: Ultimate Boss Mod
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH 2
mods.author: ClutchZ
mods.notes: Replaces normal Yo-kai with bosses so that every boss can be befriended without a save editor, with the scaling balanced in the final version 2.1. It carries the English text archive, so the USA versions are listed; the page does not say whether it is for Bony Spirits or Fleshy Souls, so both are. The download is 1 GB.

mods.name: Project Ultimate (Game Archive Version)
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH 3
mods.author: mekkiNG
mods.notes: A fan mod (Demo 2) that adds many new Yo-kai, in its ready-to-use game archive version; the other download needs the YWML mod loader and is not used. The author archived it in August 2026, so no more updates are coming. It is a 313 MB download for the English (USA) version.

mods.name: Undub
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH 3
mods.author: Younes-Bel
mods.notes: Changes all audio to Japanese, changes the BBQ text and art to USA and Blasters to Busters, and swaps Jibanyan B, Komasan B, Usapyon B and the Bustersmobile for the Japanese versions. This is the older GameBanana build: the page says to take version 1.1 from MediaFire, which the app cannot download. It only works on the base game, not the updated one, and is 389 MB.

mods.name: Yo-Kaizo Watch 3
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH 3
mods.author: charashift/opalfoxxo
mods.notes: A Kaizo difficulty mod with boss stat changes, post-game rematches, Blasters T and Zombie Night, plus playable Zombie Yo-kai, Crabbycat, Yopplebot, Sternyan and Emperor mode, and some recoloured harder bosses. It is two loose game archives (about 2.1 GB together) on the author's Google Drive, for the English (USA) version. The whole download is very large.

mods.name: Katie and Fumi over Hailey and Inaho
mods.title: YO-KAI WATCH 3
mods.author: heartbreakhavoc
mods.notes: Replaces every Hailey and Inaho model except the cutscene ones with Katie and Fumi from Yo-kai Watch 2, and swaps the BBQ house for the Katie and Fumi one. It replaces the main game archive and is a 1.5 GB download. The page does not name a region, so the USA version is listed.

mods.name: Undub
mods.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV
mods.author: Kesnos
mods.notes: Restores the Japanese audio and movies in the USA version, as a re-upload of an undub patch whose original download went down. It replaces the sound banks and movie files (about 540 MB), and the original thread has the instructions.

mods.name: Early Design Flynn
mods.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV
mods.author: ZerosPlays7
mods.notes: Turns the Samurai uniform and its menu portraits into the Early Design look from the official artwork. The author says it works on 3DS and Citra, and it is for the USA version. It replaces the player model and a few menu images.

mods.name: Main Menu HD
mods.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV
mods.author: Quantum_Dog
mods.notes: Replaces the title menu graphics with HD versions. The author says it probably does not work on a real 3DS. A colour version is on the page but is not installed.

mods.name: Nanashi She/Her Text and Dialogue
mods.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse
mods.author: Paisley_Park
mods.notes: Changes the text and dialogue so Nanashi is referred to as she/her, with feminine wording elsewhere; the voice lines are not changed and there are no story changes. The author tested it on Citra, and it does not work with DLC events.

mods.name: Zeus
mods.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse
mods.author: saad14
mods.notes: Replaces Thor with Zeus, including the model, portraits and profile text. The author tested it on Citra. It is a very small download.

mods.name: Better Intro
mods.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse
mods.author: Quantum_Dog
mods.notes: Replaces the intro movie with the game's trailer, which the author finds a better introduction. It swaps one 18 MB video file. The page does not say whether it works on a real 3DS.

mods.name: HD Nanashi Hunter Suit
mods.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse
mods.author: Quantum_Dog
mods.notes: Replaces the body, head and legs models of Nanashi's old hunter suit with higher-detail ones. The author says it probably does not work on a real 3DS and that only this one outfit is covered so far.

mods.name: Riku to Aqua
mods.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
mods.author: Cagaroo
mods.notes: Replaces Riku with Aqua in most places, with retargeted Birth by Sleep animations. This installs the Aqua-only game files; her extra Keyblades and the 625 MB voice lines are separate downloads and are not installed. It replaces the same file as Sora (KH2) and the KH1 outfits, so use only one character mod.

mods.name: Sora (KH2)
mods.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
mods.author: Cagaroo
mods.notes: Replaces Sora with his Kingdom Hearts II look, with retargeted KH2 animations. This installs the Sora-only game files; the page also offers a combined Sora and Aqua pack that is not used. It replaces the same file as Riku to Aqua and the KH1 outfits, so use only one character mod.

mods.name: KH2-Inspired Textures (Recolor)
mods.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
mods.author: Solt11
mods.notes: Changes Sora's and Riku's looks toward their Kingdom Hearts II appearances; this version mostly changes the colour scheme and keeps the original details. The files are a replacement character model archive rather than texture images, so it clashes with the other character mods. The three versions replace the same file, so install only one; the page names no region.

mods.name: KH2-Inspired Textures (KH2 Adapt)
mods.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
mods.author: Solt11
mods.notes: Changes Sora's and Riku's looks toward their Kingdom Hearts II appearances; this version is very close to Kingdom Hearts II but keeps the X on Sora's shirt and the Dream Eater symbol on Riku's. The files are a replacement character model archive rather than texture images, so it clashes with the other character mods. The three versions replace the same file, so install only one; the page names no region.

mods.name: KH2-Inspired Textures (KH2 Full)
mods.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
mods.author: Solt11
mods.notes: Changes Sora's and Riku's looks toward their Kingdom Hearts II appearances; this version is very close to Kingdom Hearts II throughout. The files are a replacement character model archive rather than texture images, so it clashes with the other character mods. The three versions replace the same file, so install only one; the page names no region.

mods.name: KH1 Outfits HUD Update
mods.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
mods.author: Sven Cakemann
mods.notes: Updates the HUD icons to the Kingdom Hearts 1 outfit versions and gives the models blinking faces, building on Isaac_MG's KH1 outfits mod. It has its own copy of the outfit models, so it replaces Play as KH1 Sora and Riku rather than adding to it. Some icon pixels are missing in the corners and the HP bar may clip.

mods.name: Play as KH1 Sora and Riku
mods.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
mods.author: Isaac_MG
mods.notes: Changes Sora's and Riku's fighting appearance to their Kingdom Hearts 1 models by replacing one 19 MB character file. It replaces the same file as the other character mods, so use only one of them. The page names no region, so the USA and Europe versions are listed.

mods.name: Advanced Vocations Keep Spells and Skills
mods.title: Dragon Quest VII: Fragments of the Forgotten Past
mods.author: The Count of Real Numbers
mods.notes: Stops characters forgetting the spells and skills they learned from advanced human vocations when they change vocation. It replaces the game's code, so it clashes with any other code patch, and the page names no region, so the USA version is listed.

mods.name: Max Tame Rate
mods.title: Dragon Quest VII: Fragments of the Forgotten Past
mods.author: The Count of Real Numbers
mods.notes: Gives every tameable monster a 25% tame rate by replacing the monster parameter file. It could clash with other mods that edit monster data, and the page names no region, so the USA version is listed.

mods.name: Turkish Patch
mods.title: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask
mods.author: Reqrefusion
mods.notes: A Turkish translation for the European (UK) version, by Reqrefusion. It replaces the game's code and icon as well as the text archives, so it clashes with other code patches. The download also has a banner and logo that Azahar does not use, and these are skipped.

mods.name: Turkish Patch
mods.title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy
mods.author: Reqrefusion
mods.notes: A Turkish translation for the European 3DS release, ported from the Switch patch by Reqrefusion. It replaces the game's code, so it clashes with other code patches, and its 132 MB data file makes the download about 113 MB. It is for the Europe version only.
